trap.label: verbo de relato
trap.wrong: Ferro said that the registrar maintain the rule.
trap.right: Ferro argued that the registrar maintained the rule.
trap.why: Português usa “disse” para tudo; inglês escolhe o verbo pela atitude (argued, maintained, declined to say).

fix.wrong: She maintain that it was fair.
fix.right: She maintained that it was fair.

fix.wrong: He argued to the rule was fair.
fix.right: He argued that the rule was fair.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com declined: “Ferro refused to say more.”
Reescreva com maintained: “She kept saying the rule was fair.”
rewrite.answer: She maintained that the rule was fair.
The rule was maintained by the registrar.
